missionAndVisionIntro: At the Intellect Pro School Foundation, the pedagogical council approved our mission and vision:
missionText: We train IT specialists who not only possess deep professional knowledge but also have well-developed critical thinking, creativity, and fluency in English. Our graduates confidently build careers in international environments and become in‑demand professionals.
visionText: Our school is a center for nurturing new‑generation leaders ready to realize their potential in any field, communicate freely, and conduct business at the international level. We cultivate individuals capable of shaping the future by implementing innovations and bringing positive change to society.

features.title: Intellect Pro School — The Leader in Future Education!
features.description: We offer modern teaching methodologies that help children unlock their potential and prepare for the challenges of tomorrow.

allInOne.title: Everything in One Place!
allInOne.paragraph: We combine core education, proprietary courses (mental arithmetic, speed reading, super memory, sport stacking) and sports sections. Everything for your child's development — without unnecessary trips!

homework.title: All Homework Done at School
homework.paragraph: After classes, children complete assignments with teachers, freeing up evenings for rest. All textbooks are stored in personal lockers — no heavy backpacks!

nutrition.title: Healthy Nutrition
nutrition.paragraph: Breakfast, lunch and afternoon snack according to a well-thought-out menu. Our chefs prepare balanced meals to keep children energized all day.

englishIt.title: Advanced English and IT
englishIt.paragraph: The program focuses on IT technologies and English — key skills for a successful career in the modern world.

competitions.title: Participation in International Competitions
competitions.paragraph: Students compete in olympiads (Memoriad, World Memory Championship, etc.), testing their skills and gaining international experience.

clubs.title: Clubs and Sections
clubs.paragraph: Football, basketball, physical therapy, public speaking, logic — we develop talents while saving your time.

AboutSection.title: Intellect pro school
AboutSection.paragraph: We integrate core academics with specialized courses (mental math, speed reading, memory training) and athletics. One location handles everything: scheduling, meals, and homework help. Students grow skills, compete globally, and future-proof themselves with intensive IT and English programs.
